# Welcome to gh-cleaner

This project keeps old GitHub Actions history and artifacts tidy without touching workflow files or source code.

## How to get started

1. Introduce yourself.
2. Browse a `good first issue`.
3. Join [Discord](https://discord.gg/Jm4XStx4Pf).
4. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Categories

- Ideas
- Q&A
- Show and Tell
- Announcements
